module: Module 4: Applied Systems, Cloud & Software Engineering
question: Which cloud service model gives a customer virtual machines on which it manages the guest operating system and its applications?

options.A: Platform as a Service (PaaS)
options.B: Software as a Service (SaaS)
options.C: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS)
options.D: A deployment model called private cloud

explanation: IaaS exposes computing infrastructure and leaves guest software administration with the customer.

module: Module 4: Applied Systems, Cloud & Software Engineering
question: A team deploys application source to a provider-managed runtime without administering the underlying operating system. Which service model best matches this capability?

options.A: A Type 2 hypervisor
options.B: Software as a Service (SaaS)
options.C: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS)
options.D: Platform as a Service (PaaS)

explanation: PaaS hosts customer applications while the provider operates the underlying runtime platform and infrastructure.

module: Module 4: Applied Systems, Cloud & Software Engineering
question: Employees use a provider-operated online payroll application and configure only tenant settings. Which service model is illustrated?

options.A: Software as a Service (SaaS)
options.B: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS)
options.C: Hardware virtualization as a deployment model
options.D: Platform as a Service (PaaS)

explanation: The capability consumed is the finished provider application, which makes it SaaS.

module: Module 4: Applied Systems, Cloud & Software Engineering
question: Which deployment model reserves a cloud infrastructure for one organization, even if a third party operates it off premises?

options.A: Private cloud
options.B: Public cloud
options.C: Multi-cloud using two public providers
options.D: A public cloud made private merely by a login page

explanation: Exclusive organizational use defines a private cloud. Its physical location and operator need not be the organization's own premises and staff.

module: Module 4: Applied Systems, Cloud & Software Engineering
question: A hypervisor runs directly on physical hardware rather than as an application on a conventional host operating system. What is its classification?

options.A: Guest operating system
options.B: Type 1 hypervisor
options.C: Ordinary application container
options.D: Type 2 hypervisor

explanation: A Type 1 hypervisor operates at the hardware virtualization layer; a Type 2 hypervisor runs on a host OS.

module: Module 4: Applied Systems, Cloud & Software Engineering
question: Which component do ordinary Linux containers on one Linux host share?

options.A: One mandatory root filesystem shared without isolation
options.B: A single process identifier shared by all container processes
options.C: One mandatory guest kernel per container
options.D: The host Linux kernel

explanation: Containers isolate processes and resources while sharing the host kernel. Their filesystems and process views can be isolated.

module: Module 4: Applied Systems, Cloud & Software Engineering
question: Which action is vertical scaling of a single server?

options.A: Removing idle servers after demand falls
options.B: Deploying the same-sized server in another region
options.C: Changing it from 4 vCPUs and 8 GiB RAM to 8 vCPUs and 16 GiB RAM
options.D: Adding four identical servers behind a load balancer

explanation: Vertical scaling changes the resources of an individual machine; adding instances is horizontal scaling.

module: Module 4: Applied Systems, Cloud & Software Engineering
question: A service automatically adds instances during a traffic spike and removes them afterward. Which capability is most directly demonstrated?

options.A: Mandatory use of SaaS
options.B: Immutable storage
options.C: A fixed-capacity deployment
options.D: Elasticity

explanation: Elasticity adjusts provisioned capacity outward and inward with demand. Here automation performs both adjustments.

module: Module 4: Applied Systems, Cloud & Software Engineering
question: For a conventional IaaS virtual machine, which task normally remains with the customer under shared responsibility?

options.A: Replacing failed physical server power supplies
options.B: Patching the provider hypervisor
options.C: Securing physical access to the provider data center
options.D: Applying security patches to the guest operating system

explanation: The provider handles physical infrastructure and virtualization. Customers administer guest operating systems and their installed software.

module: Module 4: Applied Systems, Cloud & Software Engineering
question: A retailer retains a private cloud and connects it to a public cloud so applications can burst into the public capacity during peaks. Which deployment description is most precise?

options.A: Hybrid cloud with application portability between distinct clouds
options.B: Private cloud only, because a private component exists
options.C: Two unconnected private clouds
options.D: Public cloud only, because peak capacity is public

explanation: The integrated private and public infrastructures remain distinct while supporting workload portability, which fits hybrid cloud.

module: Module 4: Applied Systems, Cloud & Software Engineering
question: A company independently runs analytics on public provider A and email on public provider B. It has no private cloud or integrated portability layer. Which description fits the stated facts?

options.A: A private-public hybrid cloud
options.B: Multi-cloud use of two public providers
options.C: A single-provider public cloud
options.D: An on-premises private cloud

explanation: Multi-cloud refers to using multiple cloud providers. The scenario supplies no private-cloud component or integrated hybrid arrangement.

module: Module 4: Applied Systems, Cloud & Software Engineering
question: A legacy application requires a customer-installed kernel module that its managed application platform prohibits. Which move gives the needed guest-kernel control with provider-managed physical hardware?

options.A: Move it to a SaaS tenant setting
options.B: Run it in an IaaS virtual machine with a compatible guest OS
options.C: Change only the application's DNS name
options.D: Put the same module in an ordinary unprivileged container on that prohibited platform

explanation: IaaS allows control of the guest operating system, subject to virtual hardware support. Tenant settings and an unprivileged container do not grant prohibited kernel access.

module: Module 4: Applied Systems, Cloud & Software Engineering
question: A SaaS tenant accidentally grants all employees access to confidential payroll records through its own role configuration. Which statement best assigns responsibility for that configuration?

options.A: The hypervisor vendor must change the payroll permissions
options.B: The customer must correct its tenant access policy
options.C: The provider is automatically responsible for every customer-selected role
options.D: SaaS eliminates the need for identity and access administration

explanation: Consuming SaaS reduces infrastructure work but does not eliminate customer responsibility for tenant identities, role choices, and data access.

module: Module 4: Applied Systems, Cloud & Software Engineering
question: A managed platform patches its OS and runtime, but a customer deploys an application with an SQL injection flaw. Under the stated boundary, who must fix the application code?

options.A: The customer application team
options.B: Only the data-center physical security team
options.C: Only the hypervisor manufacturer
options.D: Nobody, because PaaS prevents application defects

explanation: The provider operates the platform; application logic remains customer-controlled. Managed runtime maintenance does not repair customer business logic.

module: Module 4: Applied Systems, Cloud & Software Engineering
question: A developer runs a desktop virtualization program as an application on an existing laptop OS, then installs a guest OS inside it. Which layer is the virtualization program?

options.A: The guest application's container image
options.B: A SaaS application runtime by definition
options.C: A Type 1 hypervisor running directly on bare metal
options.D: A Type 2 hypervisor

explanation: A hosted virtualization program runs above a conventional host OS, matching Type 2 virtualization.

module: Module 4: Applied Systems, Cloud & Software Engineering
question: A deployment must run a Linux application and an application requiring a Windows kernel simultaneously on one physical server. Which design directly supplies the distinct kernels?

options.A: Two ordinary Linux containers sharing one Linux kernel
options.B: Two directory trees on one Linux host without virtualization
options.C: Separate Linux and Windows guest VMs on a suitable hypervisor
options.D: Two processes in the same Linux container namespace

explanation: Separate VMs can boot distinct guest kernels. Ordinary containers share their host kernel and do not themselves turn a Linux kernel into a Windows kernel.

module: Module 4: Applied Systems, Cloud & Software Engineering
question: An application stores session state only in each server's RAM. Traffic is randomly balanced to newly added servers without affinity. What directly addresses the resulting lost sessions during horizontal scaling?

options.A: Move session state to a shared service accessible to all application instances
options.B: Keep adding servers while assuming all instance RAM is shared
options.C: Use a larger logo on the login page
options.D: Double only the number of independent in-memory session copies without synchronization

explanation: New instances do not inherit another process's memory. A shared session service allows every instance to retrieve the same session state; that dependency needs its own availability design.

module: Module 4: Applied Systems, Cloud & Software Engineering
question: An autoscaling group reaches its configured maximum of ten instances while demand keeps rising. Which conclusion is justified?

options.A: Elastic growth is currently constrained by the configured capacity limit
options.B: Cloud elasticity guarantees unlimited usable capacity despite every limit
options.C: Every request must now succeed because autoscaling is enabled
options.D: The deployment has automatically become a private cloud

explanation: Configured maxima, service quotas, and available resources bound real scaling. Enabling an autoscaler does not remove those constraints.

module: Module 4: Applied Systems, Cloud & Software Engineering
question: Two container replicas run on one host. The design must survive that host's complete failure. Which change directly removes this shared host dependency for the replicas?

options.A: Assign both containers more CPU on the same host
options.B: Give both existing containers different names
options.C: Place replicas on separate hosts and route traffic to healthy replicas
options.D: Add a third container on the same host

explanation: Failure-domain separation is required: every container on a failed host loses that host. Independent hosts and health-aware routing address the specified failure.

module: Module 4: Applied Systems, Cloud & Software Engineering
question: A provider supplies an exclusively allocated cloud to one company from the provider's data center. The company says it cannot be private because it is off premises. Which correction is accurate?

options.A: Private clouds must be operated only by the customer's employees
options.B: Private-cloud classification depends on exclusive organizational use, not an on-premises requirement
options.C: Any off-premises cloud is necessarily public
options.D: Exclusive allocation always means the service must be SaaS

explanation: A private cloud may be operated by a third party and located off premises; exclusive organizational use is the relevant deployment characteristic.

module: Module 4: Applied Systems, Cloud & Software Engineering
question: A service can be manually expanded from two to twenty instances, but stays at twenty when demand drops unless an operator intervenes. What does the scenario directly establish?

options.A: It is automatically elastic in both directions
options.B: It is horizontally scalable; automatic scale-in has not been demonstrated
options.C: It cannot be scalable because scaling is manual
options.D: It must use vertical scaling only

explanation: Scalability is the ability to accommodate growth by adding capacity. The described manual process does not establish automatic demand-following contraction.

module: Module 4: Applied Systems, Cloud & Software Engineering
question: An application provider meters storage and request counts and reports them to each tenant. Which cloud characteristic is most directly illustrated?

options.A: A prohibition on customer usage visibility
options.B: Dedicated physical hardware for every tenant
options.C: Measured service
options.D: A requirement that every resource be free

explanation: Metering and reporting consumption provide usage transparency. They do not imply a particular deployment model or pricing level.

module: Module 4: Applied Systems, Cloud & Software Engineering
question: A small web application needs only a supported managed runtime and must avoid routine guest-OS administration. Which choice best fits that requirement among the options?

options.A: An on-premises server with a manually maintained OS
options.B: PaaS application hosting
options.C: IaaS VMs managed entirely by the application team
options.D: A desktop Type 2 hypervisor maintained by the application team

explanation: The managed runtime satisfies the application need while delegating underlying OS maintenance. The other choices keep that administration with the team.

module: Module 4: Applied Systems, Cloud & Software Engineering
question: A disaster-recovery design copies a VM image nightly but keeps the only current database on the original host's local disk. The host and disk fail together. What gap most directly prevents recovery of recent application data?

options.A: The design has no surviving copy of the current database state
options.B: Virtualization automatically preserves every write after disk loss
options.C: The VM image contains too many operating-system files
options.D: Using a private IP address guarantees database durability

explanation: A VM image is not a substitute for current database backups or replication. Recovery requires database state stored outside the failed disk's failure domain.

module: Module 4: Applied Systems, Cloud & Software Engineering
question: Three independent availability zones must serve 450 requests/second immediately after loss of any one zone. Each instance serves at most 100 requests/second; instances are distributed equally, traffic can rebalance perfectly, and no new instances can start during failover. What is the minimum deployment?

options.A: 1 instance per zone, 3 instances total
options.B: 2 instances per zone, 6 instances total
options.C: 3 instances per zone, 9 instances total
options.D: 4 instances per zone, 12 instances total

explanation: With k instances per zone, two surviving zones supply 200k requests/second. 200k>=450 requires k=3; k=2 supplies only 400.

module: Module 4: Applied Systems, Cloud & Software Engineering
question: A three-voter service requires a majority of two live voters. It must retain a majority after any single availability-zone failure. Which placement meets this requirement?

options.A: One voter in each of three independent zones
options.B: Two voters in zone A and one in zone B
options.C: One voter in zone A and two in zone B
options.D: All three voters in one zone

explanation: Spreading one voter across each of three zones leaves two after any one-zone loss. A 2+1 placement loses its majority if the two-voter zone fails.

module: Module 4: Applied Systems, Cloud & Software Engineering
question: An API is duplicated across two public clouds, but every request in both clouds synchronously requires one shared identity endpoint. That endpoint fails completely and cached credentials are not accepted. What follows?

options.A: Exactly one cloud must remain able to authenticate every request
options.B: The API copies automatically remove the authentication requirement
options.C: Both API deployments can become unusable despite their separate clouds
options.D: Multi-cloud deployment makes the shared endpoint failure impossible

explanation: Provider diversity does not remove an application-level shared dependency. The explicitly required identity endpoint is a common point of failure.

module: Module 4: Applied Systems, Cloud & Software Engineering
question: Two interchangeable application instances each have availability 0.99. The application tier works if either is available. Every request also needs a database with availability 0.999. All three component failures are independent, and routing has no failures. What is total availability?
explanation: The application tier availability is 1-(0.01)^2=0.9999. Multiplying by 0.999 for the required database gives 0.9989001, or 99.89001%.

module: Module 4: Applied Systems, Cloud & Software Engineering
question: A workload jumps immediately to 900 requests/second. New instances take five minutes to become ready, and neither queuing nor request rejection is allowed. Each warm instance handles at most 150 requests/second. Warm instances must be split equally across three zones and still handle the spike after any one-zone loss. How many warm instances are minimally needed before the spike?

options.A: 6 warm instances, 2 per zone
options.B: 3 warm instances, 1 per zone
options.C: 12 warm instances, 4 per zone
options.D: 9 warm instances, 3 per zone

explanation: If k warm instances occupy each zone, loss of one leaves 2k*150 capacity. Meeting 900 requires k>=3. Slow scale-out cannot supply capacity immediately.

module: Module 4: Applied Systems, Cloud & Software Engineering
question: Two replicas of a critical VM have automated restart, but both reside on one physical host and use one local disk. A proposed design must survive destruction of that host and disk without losing acknowledged writes. Which option addresses both stated requirements?

options.A: Use asynchronous nightly copies on the same local disk
options.B: Increase the one host's CPU count and restart the same VMs
options.C: Add more VM replicas on the same host and local disk
options.D: Use separate hosts and storage failure domains, synchronously replicate acknowledged writes, and provide health-based failover

explanation: Host separation supplies surviving execution capacity; synchronous durable replication outside the failed storage domain preserves acknowledged writes. Failover must route to the surviving copy.
